credits.title: Very Very Strange Love
credits.overview: Songi is a very, very peculiar woman. Pressured by her mother, she attends blind dates daily and drifts into sexual fantasies about men she feels no attraction to.

credits.title: The Corner
credits.overview: On Song-yi’s way of getting water, she bumps her private area on the corner of the desk Dong-yeong was pushing. Feeling something she’s never felt before she goes on her journey of finding that desk again.
